nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender at deployment and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address staged by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set to srh1 in the constructor.
Public token name string, set in the constructor.
Public token decimals value, set to 0 in the constructor.
Total token supply, set once in the constructor to 100000000000000000.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; credited in constructor and mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount, written by approve/approveAndCall and reduced by transferFrom.
Pure helper performing a + b with a require(c >= a) overflow guard.
Pure helper performing a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
Pure helper performing a * b with a division-based overflow guard.
Pure helper performing a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned constructor assigning the deployer (msg.sender) as owner.
onlyOwner function staging a new owner address in newOwner.
Two-step ownership handover; requires msg.sender == newOwner then promotes newOwner to owner.
Token constructor that initializes metadata, mints the whole supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer debiting msg.sender via safeSub and crediting the recipient via safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no double-spend protection.
Spends an allowance: debits from, reduces allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits to.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the untrusted spender contract before returning.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts to reject plain ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary caller-supplied token contract.
Attacker controllable caller used to set owner and to satisfy the onlyOwner access check.
Attacker controllable caller used as the balance/allowance key in transfer, approve, transferFrom and as the forwarded from address in approveAndCall.
Attacker controllable caller compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership.
Integer addition c = a + b whose safety relies only on the require(c >= a) post-condition.
Integer subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a); reverts instead of wrapping.
Integer multiplication c = a * b with overflow detection via c / a == b.
Integer division c = a / b guarded against division by zero.
External call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval executing arbitrary untrusted code after allowance state changes.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied contract address.
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control gate in the onlyOwner modifier.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) access-control gate in acceptOwnership.
Unconditional revert in the payable fallback; no state change occurs.

edges.reason: Owned constructor reads the untrusted msg.sender to seed ownership.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares untrusted msg.sender against owner.
onlyOwner require gate controls execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner require gate controls execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
acceptOwnership compares untrusted msg.sender against newOwner.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) gates acceptOwnership execution.
acceptOwnership clears the newOwner staging variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
_newOwner argument flows into the newOwner assignment.
Untrusted msg.sender indexes the balances mapping debited by transfer.
Untrusted msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping written by approve.
Untrusted msg.sender keys the allowance diminished by transferFrom.
Untrusted msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument to the external receiveApproval callback.
transfer delegates sender balance debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates recipient balance credit to safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance debits to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates recipient balance credit to safeAdd.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the untrusted spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into a caller-supplied token contract.
safeAdd executes the guarded integer addition.
safeSub executes the guarded integer subtraction.
safeMul executes the guarded integer multiplication.
safeDiv executes the guarded integer division.
Fallback function reaches the unconditional revert.
Constructor assigns the token symbol.
Constructor assigns the token name.
Constructor assigns the decimals value.
Constructor writes the fixed total supply.
Constructor credits the full supply into balances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for the burn adjustment.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes into the allowed mapping before the callback.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the rescued tokens to the owner address.
acceptOwnership reads the current owner for the OwnershipTransferred event.
transferOwnership stores the staged newOwner value.
acceptOwnership reads and clears newOwner.
safeAdd operand a is read.
safeAdd operand b is read.
safeAdd writes its return variable c.
safeSub operand a is read.
safeSub operand b is read.
safeSub writes its return variable c.
safeMul operand a is read.
safeMul operand b is read.
safeMul writes its return variable c.
safeDiv operand a is read.
safeDiv operand b is read.
safeDiv writes its return variable c.
balanceOf uses tokenOwner as the mapping key.
balanceOf writes its return variable balance.
transfer uses the to argument as the credit key.
transfer uses the tokens argument as the moved amount.
transfer writes its success return flag.
approve uses spender as the allowance key.
approve stores the tokens allowance amount.
approve writes its success return flag.
transferFrom uses from as the debit key.
transferFrom uses to as the credit key.
transferFrom uses tokens as the moved amount.
transferFrom writes its success return flag.
allowance uses tokenOwner as the outer mapping key.
allowance uses spender as the inner mapping key.
allowance writes its remaining return variable.
approveAndCall uses spender both as allowance key and as callback target.
approveAndCall stores the tokens allowance amount.
approveAndCall forwards the data blob into the external call.
approveAndCall writes its success return flag.
transferAnyERC20Token uses tokenAddress as the external call target.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards tokens to the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token returns the success flag.
transfer tokens argument reaches the safeSub subtraction on the sender balance.
transferFrom tokens argument reaches safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom tokens argument reaches the safeAdd credit.
tokenAddress argument directly determines the untrusted external call destination.
spender argument directly determines the untrusted receiveApproval callback destination.
